coverage: 2000-present: 2002-2022 weather emergencies from the Department of Emergency and Military Affairs annual and State Emergency Council reports, with 2014 and 2021-2022 dates from news coverage of each declaration; January 2023-present from the Governor's news releases (dated by release) and executive orders. Governor Hull's 2000-2001 weather emergencies (Mohave County windstorm, August 2000; Wenden flood and rain from Hurricane Olivia, October 2000; southwest Arizona monsoon, August 2001) are known only by month from the Auditor General's 2004 report and are not listed, and some 2014-2017 and 2021-2023 declarations named in Governor's Emergency Fund reports have no published date and are not listed
